loop: CANDIDATE -> TECHNICAL DIAGNOSIS (limiting variable + direction) -> TECHNICAL MUTATION (actual design variable) -> INDEPENDENT TECHNICAL EVALUATION -> EVIDENCE/PRIOR-ART RECHECK -> KEEP/KILL -> SECOND IMPROVEMENT

MAX_ITERATIONS_DEFAULT.justification: the CEO milestone is DIAGNOSE -> TECHNICAL MUTATION -> RE-EVALUATE -> SECOND IMPROVEMENT; two iterations demonstrate repeatability at bounded cost

MAX_PROPOSALS_PER_ITERATION.justification: bounded proposal budget, identical to the R378 epistemic loop: three attempts, then the honest no-defensible-mutation verdict

VALUE_CLASS_STRICTNESS.justification: EXTRACTED claims are span-verified or rejected (Art. II/VI); MODELLED values are admitted only when declared; an unbounded parameter is immutable (ADR_R379 anti-gaming)

mutation_kinds_reserved.ARCHITECTURE_CHANGE: needs a structural/control search space at a higher fidelity tier (ADR_R379)
mutation_kinds_reserved.CONTROL_POLICY_CHANGE: needs a structural/control search space at a higher fidelity tier (ADR_R379)

keep_criterion: the child's OWN independent technical evaluation must confirm the objective improves in the mutation direction with constraints preserved — a score increase is NEVER sufficient (CEO R379 item 4/8)
outcome_reason: the candidate's own custodied evidence yields no quantifiable technical objective+leverage (admitted: {"parameters": 7, "parameters_with_value": 0, "parameters_extracted": 0, "parameters_modelled": 0, "parameters_with_envelope": 0, "constraints": 0, "objectives": 5, "dependencies": 4, "objects": 2, "failure_modes": 3}); the technical layer cannot engage — an honest measured gap (the 🟡 state), not a kill and not a failure

objects.name: battery enclosure with integrated thermal regulators
objects.role: containment system for lithium battery thermal events

objects.name: semitransparent perovskite thermal regulator
objects.role: converts excess heat into visible light for dissipation

parameters.name: heat-to-light conversion efficiency
parameters.role: effectiveness of converting thermal energy to visible light

parameters.name: optical transparency
parameters.role: ability to allow visual monitoring of thermal status

parameters.name: battery operating temperature
parameters.role: temperature range at which the battery must remain within safe operational limits

parameters.name: operational stability duration
parameters.role: duration the perovskite thermal regulator maintains functionality before degradation

parameters.name: battery enclosure mass
parameters.role: mass of the battery enclosure system including thermal regulators

parameters.name: battery enclosure volume
parameters.role: volume occupied by the battery enclosure system including thermal regulators

parameters.name: perovskite degradation rate
parameters.role: rate at which the perovskite material degrades under operating conditions

constraints.justification: battery temperature must remain within safe operational limits to prevent thermal events
mass of battery enclosure system must be bounded by aircraft design constraints
volume of battery enclosure system must be bounded by aircraft design constraints
degradation rate must be minimized to ensure long-term stability and durability

objectives.basis: maintain battery temperature within safe limits to prevent thermal events
allow visual monitoring of thermal status for early detection of issues
extend operational lifetime of the perovskite thermal regulators
reduce mass penalty on aircraft design
reduce volume penalty on aircraft design

failure_modes.name: battery thermal event
failure_modes.problem_link: onboard battery thermal event containment failure

failure_modes.name: perovskite material degradation
failure_modes.problem_link: loss of thermal regulation capability due to material degradation

failure_modes.name: reduced optical transparency
failure_modes.problem_link: inability to visually monitor thermal status

dependencies.statement: higher battery temperature increases heat-to-light conversion efficiency
higher operating temperature increases the rate of perovskite material degradation
higher degradation rate reduces optical transparency of the perovskite material
higher heat-to-light conversion efficiency reduces battery operating temperature

objective.basis: maintain battery temperature within safe limits to prevent thermal events

uncertainty.note: UNKNOWN values are never treated as zeros; unverifiable constraints are never treated as satisfied (Art. XXV / Art. IV)

conventions.name: ORDINAL_LEVERAGE_BY_PATH_LENGTH
conventions.justification: with MONOTONE-only relations the evaluator cannot rank leverage by magnitude; it ranks by (1) fewest constraint blocks, (2) shortest causal path from the parameter to the objective target, (3) envelope provenance class (EXTRACTED beats MODELLED). This is a declared ordinal convention, not a measurement — recorded on every evaluation that uses it.
conventions.uncertainty: ordinal only; magnitudes are UNKNOWN at this tier

conventions.name: DIRECTIONAL_FAIL_CLOSED
conventions.justification: a proposed change is constraint-BLOCKED when (a) the changed parameter's own numeric constraint would be violated at the proposed value, or (b) a relation-connected constraint target is already VIOLATED or value-UNKNOWN and the predicted direction moves it TOWARD its bound. Fail-closed on directional risk: an unknown-position target moving toward a bound is a blocked move, not an accepted one (Art. IV).

steps: checked 0 constraint(s) numerically where values exist

fidelity_escalation.deciding_question: does a design-variable change improve the objective within constraints?
fidelity_escalation.note: higher tiers (NUMERICAL_SOLVER / SIMULATION / NEURAL_OPERATOR) are contract-reserved and not registered; escalation is recorded, never faked at the current tier
